newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Metal to boost Besshi smelter capacity.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Metal to boost Besshi smelter capacity.

text.p: Japan's third largest copper producer Sumitomo Metal Mining Co said on Wednesday it planned to raise smelting capacity at its Besshi plant by the end of this century.
The company will raise Besshi's smelting capacity by 20,000 tonnes a year to 296,000 tonnes by the year 2000 in line with an increase in its refining capacity, said Sumitomo official Yusuke Niwa.
But Niwa said the company planned no capital investment in the 1997/98 fiscal year for the hike in smelting capacity.

On Tuesday, Sumitomo Metal said it would spend 2.1 billion yen in the year ending March 31, 1998 to expand Besshi's annual refining capacity to 230,000 tonnes from 210,000 currently. It said it would lift the refining capacity to 250,000 tonnes by the year 2000.
